hook: In 2010, two Bitcoin blocks erased 100 bitcoin.

scenes.narration: Blocks ninety-one thousand eight hundred forty-two and ninety-one thousand eight hundred eighty overwrote two earlier coinbase transactions.
That made another hundred bitcoin unspendable.
The protocol has been refined since. Early Bitcoin was still being worked out.

cta: Did you know this one? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: The 2010 Bitcoin Blocks That Erased 100 BTC
description_body: Two blocks in November 2010 overwrote earlier coinbase transactions.
